scientific.integrity: The defining FR update is specialized exactly to a quadratic family with fixed follower and Schur-complement curvatures. A ridge-error coordinate triangularizes the map and gives closed forms for distinct and repeated eigenvalues; the transient lower bound is an explicit one-step equality.
limitations: Scalar quadratic two-player sequential minimax family.
Exact deterministic Hessian correction with fixed positive steps.
Euclidean-state transient amplification rather than a stochastic or nonlinear performance theorem.
The construction varies raw cross-coupling while preserving the two asymptotic modal eigenvalues.

title: Follow-the-Ridge can hide arbitrarily large transients behind a fixed real spectrum
